summary: Full backend + frontend verification of the new Partner Settlements feature (Money > Partner Dues). Wrote and ran /app/backend/tests/test_partner_settlements.py (12 tests, all passing) covering GET partner-dues aggregation math, full payment lifecycle (create -> partial -> overpay -> reverse -> double-reverse 409), non-positive amount rejection, missing store_id, list filtering, and RBAC (POST/reverse 403 for store_manager, GET allowed per money:view ladder). Ran existing regression suites (finledger reversal/F1 GL unification, sidebar RBAC contract, RBAC gate contract) — all pass. UI-tested end-to-end via Playwright as accounts1: Record Payment form disabled-submit on empty/zero amount, enabled on valid amount, submission updates Owed/Paid/Outstanding cards and history table live, overpayment/reversal math correct on-screen. Verified RBAC in UI as deo.manager (store_manager): page renders read-only (no Record Payment buttons), matching the documented money:view/money:manage ladder. Verified Vendor Ledger and Partner Billing Policy pages still render correctly (no regression).
critical_code_review_comments: Code is clean and well-documented (extensive docstrings explaining rationale, matches existing codebase style). No BILL kind on PartnerLedgerEntry is a deliberate, well-justified design (billed side stays StoreTransfer.partner_billing_value_paise).

GL bridge correctly deferred-imports BillingPolicy to avoid circular import; only fires under GL_POSTING mode — verified via test that dual (informational vs gl_posting) behavior isn't broken (billing_mode was 'informational' throughout my test run, GL leg posting untested live but logic mirrors the already-tested vendor/bill pattern and previous session's manual curl testing per handoff notes).
AlreadyReversedError -> 409 mapping is correct and idempotent double-reversal is blocked at both the reverses-FK-exists check and the kind==REVERSAL check.

Minor observation (not a bug): the RBAC pattern for GET is intentionally permissive at money:view — a store_manager (holding money:operate on the ladder) can read the full partner-dues report and settlement history for ALL partner stores (not scoped to their own store), same as the pre-existing PartnerDuesView behavior. This is consistent with 'money' being a network-wide (non-store-scoped) section throughout the codebase, so not a new issue introduced by this feature — just noting for awareness since Partner Dues data (dues owed by other stores) becomes visible read-only to any store manager network-wide.
test_credentials: accounts1/Acct@123 (finance), deo.manager/Store@123 (non-finance RBAC negative test) — both from /app/memory/test_credentials.md, worked as documented.
seed_data_creation: None — reused existing BANKA (store_id=5) partner-store seed data left over from main agent's manual testing session; my own test run added and then reversed a few more PSET entries (net zero effect on final balances since all test-created settlements were reversed at the end of the pytest run).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Partner Settlements feature (backend + frontend) is fully working: create/partial/overpay/reverse/double-reverse-409/RBAC all verified via both pytest (test_partner_settlements.py, KDPS_TEST_ALLOW_REMOTE=1 required to run against the live preview DB) and Playwright UI flows. Vendor Ledger and Partner Billing Policy pages confirmed unaffected. One transient 429 rate-limit was hit during rapid-fire UI test navigation (not a real bug — retried after 30s and it resolved cleanly), so if a future agent sees a blank page after several fast navigations, wait and retry before flagging.
rca_of_the_issue: No unresolved bugs found. No RCA needed.
